prompt: Create an app icon sprite sheet with exactly FIVE icons in the attached six-square lattice. The canvas has exactly two columns and three rows. Every square occupies exactly half the canvas width and one third of its height: 512 by 512 pixels at the requested resolution. The five occupied squares are Settings at top-left, Search at top-right, Home at middle-left, Files at middle-right, and Folder at bottom-left. The bottom-right square is deliberately unused: leave that entire square plain white, without any symbol. This blank square is the only permitted empty space; do not leave an entire row empty. Preserve all six square positions and boundaries exactly. Each occupied square has a solid-color background reaching all four edges and all four sharp 90-degree corners. Adjacent squares touch. NO rounded tile corners, gutters, padding, outer margins, footer, extra bands, captions, or exterior shadows. Replace all checkerboards and guide lines with the specified backgrounds. Use crisp white symbols with subtle internal depth. If output resolution differs, scale the entire lattice uniformly; do not change the canvas proportions or cell proportions.

cells.prompt: A white gear on a solid blue square background.
A white magnifying glass on a solid purple square background.
A white house on a solid orange square background.

This bottom-right square is a blank control region, not a sixth asset. Leave it entirely plain white. No symbol, texture, guide border, or shadow.
